jobs.title: Private Markets Technology (BPMT), Innovation and Implementation Lead, Director
jobs.description:
Location: New York, New York Team: Implementation Job Requisition \#: R265954 Date posted: Aug. 31, 2026
  
**Job description**
-------------------


**About this role**


**About this Role:**
  

The BlackRock Private Markets Technology (BPMT) team within Aladdin Engineering is seeking a Director\-level business architect and technology strategy leader to help scale BlackRock’s private markets platform across investment teams, product strategy, engineering, data, operations, and client\-facing capabilities.


BPMT is dedicated to digitally transforming BlackRock’s private markets investment teams by translating business strategy into executable technology architecture, implementation roadmaps, data and operating\-model requirements, and measurable adoption outcomes. The team partners deeply with Aladdin Product Management, Aladdin Engineering, Data, Operations, Risk, Implementation, and end business users to ensure private markets technology is designed, delivered, adopted, and run in a way that scales BlackRock’s business and strengthens Aladdin’s broader private markets platform.


The team sits at the intersection of Private Markets business and technology. BPMT acts as the connective tissue between investment professionals, product strategy, engineering delivery, data integrity, operating controls, analytics, reporting, and user adoption. The Director will be based in New York City and will directly face off with investment teams and product strategy teams to shape, prioritize, and implement technology solutions that support BlackRock’s private markets growth agenda.


**Key Responsibilities:**


* **Drive Private Markets Technology Strategy:** Partner directly with investment teams, product strategy, engineering, data, operations, and risk stakeholders to translate private markets growth objectives into actionable technology roadmaps, capability maps, and implementation plans.
* **Serve as a Forward\-Deployed Business Architect**: Engage hands\-on with end users to understand investment workflows, pain points, decision needs, operating constraints, and adoption barriers; convert those insights into practical technology solutions that scale across businesses.
* **Lead Cross\-Functional Implementation:** Own the connective operating model across Product, Engineering, Data, Operations, Risk, Implementation, and user communities so that dependencies, testing, readiness, controls, and go\-live decisions are managed as one coherent system.
* **Shape Target\-State Architecture:** Define and steward private markets business architecture across deal pipeline, portfolio management, analytics, reporting, risk, data management, operational workflows, controls, lifecycle events, and whole\-portfolio integration.
* **Translate Strategy into Execution:** Create executive\-ready decision frameworks, roadmaps, risk views, implementation plans, and operating\-model recommendations that move complex initiatives from issue identification to measurable outcomes.
* **Scale Private Markets Data and Controls:** Partner with data, operations, and engineering teams to improve data quality, establish scalable sources of truth, strengthen reconciliation and control frameworks, and enable self\-service analytics and reporting for private markets users.
* **Champion Change Management and Adoption:** Drive user engagement, readiness planning, communications, training, support models, and post\-implementation value tracking so technology solutions are adopted and sustained in business\-as\-usual operations.
* **Protect Long\-Term Platform Integrity**: Challenge tactical approaches that undermine the target\-state architecture while making pragmatic tradeoffs needed to deliver business value, manage risk, and maintain leadership confidence.

**Qualifications:**


* **Experience:** 10\+ years of experience in financial services, with a required background in private markets and a proven track record in technology, data, operations, business architecture, platform implementation, or investment\-technology transformation roles.
* **Private Markets Expertise:** Deep understanding of private markets investment workflows across one or more strategies such as Private Credit, Private Equity, Infrastructure, Real Estate, or multi\-alternative strategies; experience with front\-office, portfolio\-management, investment\-operations, or data workflows is required.
* **Technology and Transformation Background**: Demonstrated experience delivering technology, data, or operating\-model change in a complex investment\-management environment, including business process reengineering, platform implementation, workflow automation, data transformation, or large\-scale change management.
* **Strategic Business Architecture:** Ability to translate ambiguous business objectives into capability maps, product requirements, architecture principles, execution plans, decision frameworks, success measures, and adoption criteria.
* **Investment\-Team Credibility:** Proven ability to engage directly with senior investment professionals and business leaders, understand their workflows and commercial priorities, and convert user feedback into scalable technology solutions.
* **Product and Engineering Partnership:** Strong ability to partner with product strategy, engineers, data teams, and implementation specialists; familiarity with Aladdin, eFront, data platforms, analytics tooling, workflow technologies, or comparable investment\-technology ecosystems is highly valued.
* **Executive Communication**: Superior communication, facilitation, and presentation skills, with the ability to simplify complex topics, frame decisions, surface risks, and influence senior stakeholders across business and technology organizations.
* **Self\-Starter Mindset:** Entrepreneurial, proactive, and comfortable operating through ambiguity; able to develop a plan, build stakeholder engagement, drive execution discipline, and deliver outcomes without waiting for a fully defined playbook.
* **Analytical and Technical Fluency**: Strong analytical orientation and comfort working with data, platforms, reporting, analytics, and technical teams. Hands\-on experience with SQL, Python, BI tools, data platforms, or product configuration is a plus, but the role is primarily a business\-architecture and transformation leadership role.

This is a unique opportunity for a senior private markets technology leader to help shape BlackRock’s next generation of private markets capabilities. The successful candidate will be a creative solutions architect who can work directly with business users, influence product and engineering strategy, and drive business transformation from idea through adoption.  

  



For New York, NY Only the salary range for this position is USD$195,000\.00 \- USD$275,000\.00 . Additionally, employees are eligible for an annual discretionary bonus, and benefits including healthcare, leave benefits, and retirement benefits. BlackRock operates a pay\-for\-performance compensation philosophy and your total compensation may vary based on role, location, and firm, department and individual performance.
**Our benefits**
  

  

To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.


**Our hybrid work model**


BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.

  

  

**Guidance on AI use for candidates**

  

At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision\-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided **guidance** (opens in new window) on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.  

  



  

**About BlackRock**

  

  

At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well\-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.

  

  

This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.

  

  

To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com (opens in new window). We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn (opens in new window), Instagram (opens in new window), YouTube (opens in new window), X (opens in new window), and TikTok (opens in new window).  

  



BlackRock is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity to all applicants and existing employees, and we evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, creed, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy and gender identity/expression), sexual orientation, age, ancestry, physical or mental disability, marital status, political affiliation, religion, citizenship status, genetic information, veteran status, or any other basis protected under applicable federal, state, or local law. **View the** **EEOC’s Know Your Rights poster and its supplement** **(opens in new window)** **and the** **pay transparency statement** **(opens in new window)****.**


BlackRock is committed to full inclusion of all qualified individuals and to providing reasonable accommodations or job modifications for individuals with disabilities. If reasonable accommodation/adjustments are needed throughout the employment process, please email Disability.Assistance@blackrock.com (opens in new window). All requests are treated in line with our **privacy policy** (opens in new window). (opens in new window)


BlackRock will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in a manner consistent with the requirements of the law, including any applicable fair chance law.

jobs.title: Onboarding Specialist
jobs.description:
**About Us:**
Join Acara Solutions, an Aleron Company. Aleron is a global workforce and business solutions company that builds relationships and empowers the workplace. Since 1957, we have been at the forefront of the workforce industry. Our renowned portfolio of companies, including Acara Solutions, Acara Solutions India, Broadleaf Results, Lume Strategies, TalentRise, and Viaduct, delivers tailored talent solutions, workforce management, IT services, and more to meet the ever\-evolving needs of our clients. We transform the workplace for people and businesses around the world.  

  

At Acara Solutions, we go beyond delivering exceptional service. We are committed to driving meaningful impact through advancing social justice, promoting community engagement, and fostering economic empowerment in the regions we serve. Our mission is to build a global network of skilled, passionate professionals like you, empowering your growth and success every step of the way.  

  

**What Acara has to offer:**  

* Full benefits package that includes health insurance, health savings account, dental insurance, disability insurance, life insurance, vision insurance, and 401(k).


 \* \*Pay: $20\.00 \- $22\.00  

* Flexible work options available post 30 days of training
* Monday \- Friday, 8:00 am to 5:00 pm

  

**Job Summary:**  

Acara Solutions has an excellent opportunity for an Onboarding Specialist in Phoenix, AZ. The Onboarding Specialist will assist the recruitment practice with the onboarding process of recruited candidates and pay\-rolled contractors for various clients and locations. The onboarding process includes administrative oversight involving the completion of background checks, drug testing, safety training, I9s, employment and education verifications, and customer\-specific documents.  

  

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**  

* With great attention to detail, assist candidates and contractors with onboarding including working with specific orientation processes and contractor issues, including direct deposit, tax forms, workers' compensation reports, benefits administration, address changes, and vacations/PTO.
* With a focus on the details, coordinate the completion of new start paperwork, ensuring each document is accurate and completed in a timely manner through our web portal, SmartSearch Onboarding.
* Communicate regularly with individual Recruiters on the status of their candidates' onboarding.
* Administer the background check process, the drug screen test, and safety training through our third\-party vendors, ensuring that these processes are completed timely and have followed Acara's protocols for completion.
* Assist with payroll responsibilities by communicating with the contractors on the submittal of time sheets and the review and submittal of expenses and per diems into the VMS (Vendor Management Solutions) web portals.
* Assist in making payroll corrections by processing rate changes, and discounts, setting up direct deposit, and releasing and invoicing timesheets, expenses, and bonuses.
* Communicate regularly with operations corporate personnel regarding payroll changes and other employee administrative issues.
* May process and track customer\-required drug testing and security clearance paperwork as required by the customer
* Submit periodic reports to management as requested
* Responsible for various other administrative duties as directed by the Company
  

**Qualifications and Skills:**  

**Required:**  

* 1 year of experience working in an office environment
* 1 year of experience using MS Word and Excel
 **Preferred:**  

* Prior onboarding experience is highly preferred
* Strong interpersonal skills
* Bilingual (Spanish) is a plus
* Excellent written and verbal communication ability
* Experience with any VMS tools or web portals

  

**Physical Demands, Work Environment, and Travel:**  

* This role operates in a modern, hybrid work environment, utilizing technology such as laptops, video conferencing tools, cloud\-based applications, and collaborative platforms. Flexibility for remote work is supported, while in\-office settings may still involve the use of standard office equipment like computers, telephones, and printers.
* The physical demands described here are representative of those required for an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While carrying out job duties, the employee must regularly be able to speak clearly and hear effectively to communicate with others. The role also frequently requires standing, walking, using hands for fine motor tasks, and reaching with arms.

  

**Additional Information:**  

* This job description is subject to change and may be adjusted to meet the company's needs.
* Upon receiving an offer of employment, candidates will be required to undergo a background check and drug screening. Depending on the role, additional industry\-specific skills testing may also be necessary prior to placement.
  

The Aleron family of companies Acara Solutions, Aleron Shared Resources, Broadleaf Results, Lume Strategies, TalentRise, and Viaduct are proud to be Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employers. We consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, genetic information, sex, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic. We encourage and welcome applications from diverse candidates, including those with disabilities. Accommodations are available upon request for individuals participating in all stages of the selection process.  

  

Please note that applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. This position does not qualify for F\-1 OPT STEM work authorization.  

* The compensation rage provided represents our good faith representation of the high and low pay range for this position.

jobs.title: Expert Implementation Consultant-1
jobs.description:
The Expert Implementation Consultant leads complex, cross\-functional software implementations with a high degree of independence, connecting the full patient care cycle — front\-office, clinical, coding, and billing — to financial performance. This role plans and executes multi\-department onboarding for enterprise and multi\-site clients, mentors other Implementation Consultants, and serves as a trusted advisor to client leadership, escalating only genuine scope or design questions upstream.
 

**Responsibilities**

* Lead end\-to\-end implementation for enterprise or multi\-site clients, spanning registration, scheduling, documentation, coding, billing, and reporting workstreams
* Assess client operational and clinical maturity to identify where upstream gaps create downstream revenue risk
* Define and manage cross\-workstream implementation plans, coordinating project management, technical, and sales teams
* Facilitate client leadership meetings and executive steering sessions, translating operational and technical concepts for non\-technical audiences
* Identify and resolve delivery risk proactively, escalating scope or design questions to a solutions architect when requirements are not yet defined
* Mentor and train other Implementation Consultants on complex delivery patterns and client engagement
* Own client training strategy and lead refinement of onboarding materials across the implementation team
* Manage cross\-workstream readiness and post\-go\-live transition to ongoing operations
Support pre\-sales scoping input on complex or multi\-product opportunities when requested  
* 

Education: Bachelor's Degree or equivalent Technical / Business experience


Experience: 7\+ years relevant work experience; 2\-3 years at the Senior level or equivalent experience


Up to 80% travel may be required  



Visa/Work Sponsorship is not offered for this position, unless specifically detailed here.


**Compensation Range:**

$92,972\-$129,231
Compensation for this job is subject to market conditions, geographic considerations, the candidate’s unique skills and experience, state and local laws, and budget. Our commitment to pay transparency is a testament to our dedication to creating a fair, equitable, and inclusive workplace. By continuously analyzing market trends, staying abreast of changes in state laws, and making budgetary adjustments accordingly, we strive to ensure that our compensation practices reflect the value we place on our associates’ unique contributions and support their professional growth.

jobs.title: EMR Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
Description: **About PreBorn!**


PreBorn! is a national nonprofit ministry dedicated to providing life\-affirming care through clinics, telehealth, and strategic partnerships. With a growing team and expanding reach, we are committed to excellence in storytelling, donor engagement, and mission\-driven communications that save lives and souls.

**Position Summary**


The?**EMR Implementation Specialist** is responsible for supporting the successful implementation, adoption, and ongoing optimization of PreBorn!’s Electronic Medical Record (EMR) platform across affiliated pregnancy clinics.


Reporting to the?**Vice President of Virtual Care Services (VP VCS)**, this role serves as a primary bridge between PreBorn!, participating clinics, technology teams, and EMR vendors. The EMR Implementation Specialist guides clinics through implementation from initial readiness and workflow discovery through configuration, data preparation, testing, training coordination, go\-live, and post\-implementation stabilization.


This is a highly hands\-on role requiring strong project coordination, technical aptitude, clinic relationship management, and the ability to translate operational and clinical workflows into effective system processes. The successful candidate will understand that implementation success is measured not simply by deploying software, but by helping clinics confidently adopt technology that strengthens operational excellence and supports their life\-saving ministry.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* **Clinic EMR Implementation**
* **Workflow Discovery \& System Configuration**
* **Data Migration \& System Readiness**
* **Testing \& Quality Assurance**
* **Training \& Clinic Adoption**
* **Go\-Live \& Post\-Implementation Support**
* **Clinic Relationship Management**
* **Cross\-Functional Collaboration**


Partner closely with:

* Vice President of Virtual Care Services
* VCS clinical and operational leadership
* Software development and technology teams
* EMR product/project leadership
* Training and education resources
* Clinic Engagement and Client Services teams
* Compliance and security resources
* External EMR vendors and technical partners, as applicable


Serve as the voice of clinic implementation by communicating recurring workflow challenges, user feedback, system gaps, and opportunities for product improvement.

**Ministry \& Culture Expectations**


As a member of the PreBorn! team, the EMR Implementation Specialist is expected to demonstrate an unwavering commitment to Jesus Christ, the sanctity of human life, and the mission of PreBorn!.


The individual must:

* Profess Jesus Christ as Savior and Lord.
* Agree with and support PreBorn!’s Statement of Faith.
* Maintain a 100% pro\-life position.
* Participate in the prayer\-centered culture of the ministry.
* Demonstrate PreBorn!’s core values of?**Steadfast, Adaptable, Integrity, Fruitful, and Prayerful**.
* Approach clinic partners with humility, service, professionalism, and a commitment to excellence.
* Recognize technology as a tool to strengthen clinics in their mission to save lives and souls

**Physical \& Travel Requirements**

* Ability to work for extended periods using computers and virtual communication systems.
* Ability to travel periodically to participating clinics throughout the United States.
* Travel may increase during periods of active clinic implementation and go\-live.
* Ability to provide onsite implementation support for multiple consecutive days when necessary.


Requirements: **Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in healthcare administration, information systems, business, project management, or related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
* 3\+ years of experience supporting software, EMR/EHR, healthcare technology, SaaS implementation, or similar system implementations.
* Experience working directly with end users during technology implementation or adoption.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple implementation projects and competing priorities.
* Strong understanding of workflow analysis, process documentation, and change management.
* Ability to learn complex software systems quickly and translate technical concepts for nontechnical users.
* Strong project coordination and organizational skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong troubleshooting, critical\-thinking, and problem\-solving abilities.
* Ability to work effectively across clinical, operational, and technical teams.
* Willingness and ability to travel to clinics as needed during implementation and go\-live.

**Preferred**

* Direct experience implementing an?**EMR or EHR system**.
* Experience working in outpatient healthcare, women's health, pregnancy clinics, telehealth, or similar clinical environments.
* Experience with healthcare data migration and system configuration.
* Familiarity with HIPAA, healthcare privacy, role\-based access, and clinical data security principles.
* Experience conducting user acceptance testing and supporting software go\-lives.
* Experience developing implementation documentation, workflows, and training resources.
* Familiarity with project management tools and implementation methodologies.
* Experience supporting multi\-site or geographically dispersed healthcare organizations.

**Core Competencies**

* **Implementation Ownership:**?Drives assigned clinic implementations from kickoff through successful adoption.
* **Technical Aptitude:**?Quickly understands system functionality, integrations, workflows, and technical dependencies.
* **Project Management:** Maintains timelines, milestones, responsibilities, risks, and deliverables.
* **Problem Solving:** Identifies root causes and drives practical solutions.
* **Clinic Partnership:**?Builds credibility and trusted relationships with clinic leaders and staff.
* **Change Management:**?Helps users navigate operational and technology changes successfully.
* **Communication:**?Translates effectively between technical teams, clinical users, and organizational leadership.
* **Attention to Detail:** Maintains accurate configuration, documentation, testing, and implementation records.
* **Adaptability:**?Effectively supports clinics with different workflows, resources, and levels of technical maturity.

jobs.title: Project Lead - ELN/LIMS Implementation
jobs.description:
Project Manager / Business Analyst / Project Lead – ELN/LIMS Implementation (Life Sciences) About the Role
  
As a Project Manager / Business Analyst / Project Lead – ELN/LIMS Implementation , you will make an impact by leading the end\-to\-end implementation of Electronic Laboratory Notebook (ELN) and Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) solutions within regulated laboratory environments. You will be a valued member of the Life Sciences Consulting team and work collaboratively with laboratory operations, Quality, Validation, IT, business stakeholders, vendors, and cross\-functional teams to deliver compliant, scalable, and business\-aligned laboratory informatics solutions.
  
In this role, you will serve as both a project lead and business analyst, driving requirements gathering, solution implementation, validation activities, and stakeholder alignment while ensuring compliance with industry regulations and quality standards. In This Role, You Will
  
Lead end\-to\-end ELN/LIMS implementation projects from planning, requirements gathering, design, configuration, testing, validation, deployment, and post\-implementation support.
  
Partner with business stakeholders, laboratory teams, IT organizations, and vendors to gather, analyze, document, and manage business and system requirements.
  
Translate business requirements into user stories, functional specifications, process maps, and implementation roadmaps while ensuring complete traceability throughout the project lifecycle.
  
Support system configuration, customization, integrations, data migration, and adoption activities to ensure successful solution deployment.
  
Oversee validation activities including IQ/OQ/PQ, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), defect management, change control, and compliance documentation within regulated environments. Work Model
  
We strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role's business requirements, this is a remote position open to qualified applicants in the United States . Occasional travel may be required to client locations for workshops, project meetings, testing activities, training sessions, and implementation support.
  
Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work\-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.
  
The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations. What You Need to Have to Be Considered
  
Bachelor's degree in Biotechnology, Bioinformatics, Life Sciences, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  
8\+ years of experience delivering Life Sciences, laboratory informatics, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or regulated industry technology projects.
  
Experience leading ELN and/or LIMS implementation projects within laboratory environments.
  
Hands\-on experience gathering business requirements, developing functional specifications, creating process maps, and managing stakeholder expectations.
  
Strong understanding of laboratory workflows, sample management, laboratory operations, and scientific data management processes.
  
Experience supporting system configuration, integrations, data migration, testing, and deployment activities.
  
Strong knowledge of GxP, GLP, cGMP, GAMP 5, CSV, and 21 CFR Part 11 regulations and compliance requirements.
  
Experience managing User Acceptance Testing (UAT), defect management, validation activities, and project documentation.
  
Strong communication, leadership, facilitation, business analysis, and stakeholder management skills.
  
Experience working with Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid project delivery methodologies. These Will Help You Stand Out
  
Hands\-on experience with Freezerworks ELN/LIMS implementations.
  
Experience implementing laboratory informatics platforms for pharmaceutical, biotechnology, clinical research, or quality control laboratories.
  
PMP, Agile, Scrum, CBAP, or related project management and business analysis certifications.
  
Experience managing vendor relationships and third\-party implementation partners.
  
Knowledge of laboratory instruments, laboratory automation systems, and scientific software integrations.
  
Experience supporting Computer System Validation (CSV) and regulatory inspection readiness activities.
  
Familiarity with cloud\-based laboratory informatics platforms and digital laboratory transformation initiatives.
  
Experience leading global or multi\-site laboratory system deployments.
  
We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role. Salary and Other Compensation
  
The annual salary for this position is anticipated to be between $125,000 and $140,000 , depending on experience, qualifications, geographic location, skills, and other job\-related factors.
  
This position is also eligible for Cognizant's discretionary annual incentive program, based on performance and subject to the terms of Cognizant's applicable plans. Benefits
  
Cognizant offers a comprehensive and competitive benefits package designed to support the health, wellbeing, and financial security of our associates and their families, including:
  
Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance
  
401(k) plan and company contributions
  
Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)
  
Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  
Paid holidays and paid time off (PTO)
  
Paid parental leave and fertility assistance programs
  
Learning and development programs, certifications, and career advancement opportunities
  
Wellness and mental health resources
  
Career growth and internal mobility opportunities
  
Benefits may vary by location and employment status and are subject to change. Application Deadline
  
Applications will be accepted until September 30, 2026 .
  
Cognizant reserves the right to close this posting earlier based on application volume, business needs, or hiring timelines.
